title: B-phase: json_path tool governance + Interpretable-Control Step 1 (audit schema) — user-adjudicated priority B

propositions: json_path conditional rules: path ^ method ^ request-body triple condition; zero-dependency JSONPath subset ($ .key .. [N] [*]) implemented in src/policy.py (~120 lines)
